hero.description: From freelancers to photographers, designers to consultants—we design personal websites that represent your career, vision, and talents in the strongest way possible.

whatIs.label: Is This Page For You?
whatIs.title: Are You the Sole Master of Your Digital Presence?
whatIs.paragraph1: Your LinkedIn profile is important for your professional network, and your Instagram portfolio can be a visual showcase; but without your own domain and website, you are always incomplete in the digital world.
whatIs.paragraph2: When your potential clients, employers, and partners search for you on Google, what do they find? Scattered social media profiles, or a prestigious website that proves your capabilities?
whatIs.paragraph3: As Sybor Digital, we build custom websites that elegantly carry your personal voice and vision into the digital world—from freelancers to creative professionals, consultants to artists.

physical.title: Freelancers
physical.description: I want to look professional to my clients, inspire trust, and land higher-budget projects.

startup.title: Creative Professionals
startup.description: I want to showcase my design, photography, or video projects in an aesthetic portfolio that reflects my own vision.

growing.title: Consultants & Coaches
growing.description: I want a digital identity that proves my expertise, builds trust, and directly attracts my potential clients.

global.title: Career-Driven Individuals
global.description: I want to have an impressive digital resume and portfolio that sets me apart from my competitors in job applications and my industry.

whatWeDo.label: What We Do
whatWeDo.title: A Digital Identity for Your Personal Brand
whatWeDo.paragraph1: We design more than just a website; we craft a digital identity that tells your story, values, and work in the most effective way.
whatWeDo.paragraph2: We structure all critical sections, such as portfolio pages, service descriptions, an expertise blog, and contact forms, tailored to your personal brand.
whatWeDo.paragraph3: Once your site is ready, we don't leave you alone; we continue to provide support with content updates, personal SEO, and brand development.

reason1.description: Personal branding isn't just about writing code; it's strategy. We listen to your goals and build the appropriate structure.

process.label: Process
process.title: How Do We Work?
process.subtitle: The transparent steps we take while bringing your personal brand to the digital world.

discovery.title: Discovery & Brand Analysis
discovery.description: We analyze your goals, target audience, and position in the industry. We plan your site's architecture together.

design.title: Design & Concept
design.description: We create the visual identity that best expresses you, prepare the interface designs, and present them for your approval.

development.title: Development & Content Entry
development.description: We turn the designs into code, upload your existing portfolio and content to the system, and complete the testing.

launch.title: Launch & Growth Support
launch.description: We launch your site flawlessly, complete SEO setups, and support your branding journey.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Things you might be wondering about the personal website setup process.

delivery.question: How many days will it take for my portfolio site to be ready?
delivery.answer: Depending on the content scope and features, we typically deliver your project within 2-3 weeks.

pricing.question: How is the cost determined?
pricing.answer: It varies based on the features you need and the number of pages. We have packages optimized for individual professionals.

revisions.question: Can I update the content on the site myself?
revisions.answer: Absolutely. We provide you with a highly easy-to-use admin panel, so you can easily add new projects or blog posts.

maintenance.question: Do you provide post-launch technical support?
maintenance.answer: Yes, we continue to provide technical support after the site goes live and offer maintenance services when needed.

migration.question: Can you migrate my projects from Behance or Dribbble?
migration.answer: Yes. We can integrate your existing content and projects from platforms like Behance, Dribbble, Medium, etc., into your new website.

mobile.question: How are domain and hosting processes handled?
mobile.answer: We provide full support during this process. We can either handle all operations on your behalf or guide you step-by-step.
